join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!autoreply
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!autoreply
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !autoreply add|remove|editresponse|editpattern|list

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !autoreply add|remove|editresponse|editpattern|list
